explication: super-board is a Claude Code skill-and-script toolkit that turns queued board cards into reviewed, verified, merged pull requests. Its main workflow is onboard/configure, run the board, then route work through Build, QA, Review, and a verification-gated merge. Separate capabilities collect issues and product signals into Backlog cards, guard risky operations, and support UI refinement, visual summaries, and Git synchronization. The README documents the product-level flows; sampled source confirms collector behavior and shared helpers, but does not expose the complete board runtime wiring.
